summary: Fixed 5 critical bugs that caused the bot to miss profitable exits. Audited the complete pipeline end-to-end confirming all integrations are healthy. Recovery Mode lockout resolved via ADAPTIVE_FORCE_NORMAL env var.

what_happened.task: Resolve missed profit exits — bot was holding positions through full reversals
what_happened.trigger: User identified bot had held tokens that peaked +60% and reversed to -20%, earning nothing

bugs_fixed.name: No Pre-TP1 Trailing Stop
bugs_fixed.description: Trailing stop was gated on tp1_hit=True. Positions peaking before TP1 had zero protection.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added PRE_TP1_TRAILING_STOP_PCT=25% that activates at any gain >= PRE_TP1_ACTIVATE_GAIN_PCT=15%, independent of TP1.

bugs_fixed.name: Confluence Gate Data Stalemate
bugs_fixed.description: Confluence gate required 2-of-5 bearish signals. Fields like entry_volume_1h were None, keeping bearish count at 0, permanently blocking exits even through -40% drops.
bugs_fixed.fix: Lowered gate to 1-of-5. Added CONFLUENCE_HARD_REVERSAL_PCT=25% override that bypasses gate entirely.

bugs_fixed.name: God Mode State Preservation Gap
bugs_fixed.description: God Mode skipped TP1 sell correctly, but didn't set tp1_hit=True. Trailing stop never activated for God Mode positions.
bugs_fixed.fix: Force pos['tp1_hit'] = True when God Mode suppresses TP1 sell.

bugs_fixed.name: Silent Sell Failure
bugs_fixed.description: Live sell exceptions swallowed with generic except clause. Failed sells left positions open with no retry or alert.
bugs_fixed.fix: Track sell_failure_count. At >=3 failures: CRITICAL log + Slack alert + force_max_slippage=True.

bugs_fixed.name: Recovery Mode Impossible Exit Target
bugs_fixed.description: HWM was $696, current capital $94. Recovery Mode requires reaching 90% of HWM = $626. Required 566% gain to exit. Bot was permanently throttled: half position sizes, gem scan throttled.
bugs_fixed.fix: Added ADAPTIVE_FORCE_NORMAL=true env var to reset HWM to current capital and force NORMAL mode. Also added auto-reset: if drawdown >80% for >7 days, HWM auto-resets.

deployment_lessons.hetzner_console_vnc: Automated browser agents CANNOT reliably type passwords into Hetzner VNC console. The VNC input layer doesn't process synthetic keystrokes correctly for password fields.
alternative_approaches: Use expect via local terminal (requires user's own terminal, not sandbox)
Install SSH key for password-free access
Use sshpass (requires brew install, blocked by permission errors in sandbox)
User manually runs commands in their open SSH terminal
deployment_lessons.recommended_fix: Set up SSH key auth on Hetzner so future deploys can use: ssh root@5.161.126.32 'commands' without password

commits: config/settings.py - new constants for pre-TP1 and confluence override
key_lessons: Always add price-action hard override to any confluence gate — data absence must never block an exit
State flags must be set even when the corresponding action is bypassed
Recovery Mode HWM should be reset when drawdown exceeds a threshold for an extended time
Silent exception handlers are profit killers — all sell failures must surface immediately
Scan for trailing stop logic: verify it fires on gain, not just on state flag
